Name: Ginger Island Farmhouse Revamp (CP)
Author: yuninocorn
Description:
[b][size=4]General[/size][/b]
This content pack uses Content Patcher to replace the Ginger Island farmhouse texture with one that fits better into the overall building style. By default, the colors match the vanilla island farmhouse palette. With Generic Mod Config Menu, you can also select an earthy option that blends in with DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour.

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
This pack edits the tilesheet 'island_tilesheet_1' by replacing the part with the Ginger Island farmhouse. The rest of the tilesheet should not be affected and therefore shouldn't interfere with any recolor packs beyond the island farmhouse. The pack should be compatible with any mod that doesn't affect this part of the tilesheet or the ginger island west map tile placements for the island farmhouse.

[size=4][b]Installing (PC)[/b][/size]
To install this content pack, download the mod file and extract the .zip file to the 'Mods' folder in your Stardew Valley game folder.

Enjoy!
